theorems.name: Submission.norm_fderiv_radial_profile_le_of_lipschitzWith
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ξ : Rn m) (ρ : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ρ → LipschitzWith K φ → ∀ x : Rn m, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y : Rn m => φ (‖y - ξ‖ / ρ)) x‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) / ρ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
